apt_offline_enabled.description: Enable apt-offline configuration. When true, other settings below are applied.

apt_offline_sig_dir.description: Directory where signature files (e.g., *.sig) are stored.

apt_offline_cache_dir.description: Directory to use as cache before downloading packages from the internet.

apt_offline_download_dir.description: Directory to download packages when no explicit --download-dir is provided.

apt_offline_threads.description: Number of threads for concurrent downloads (1 recommended to avoid overload).

apt_offline_bundles_dir.description: Directory where bundle (.zip) files are stored.

apt_offline_proxies.description: List of proxy configurations to use during get operations. Each entry specifies host, optional port, and optional scheme (http/https). Only the first entry is used by apt-offline at runtime, but schema allows future extensibility.

apt_offline_https_auth.description: HTTPS client-authentication credentials. Contains cert_file and key_file paths.

apt_offline_http_basicauth_urls.description: List of URLs with embedded basic auth (e.g., 'user:pass@example.com'). Encoded per RFC-3986.

apt_offline_disable_cert_check.description: Disable HTTPS certificate verification (not recommended in production).

apt_offline_apt_backend.description: APT backend to use: one of 'apt', 'apt-get', or 'python-apt'.

apt_offline_skip_changelog.description: Skip display of changelog during install operations.

apt_offline_skip_bug_reports.description: Skip listing of bug reports during install operations.

apt_offline_allow_unauthenticated.description: Skip GPG signature verification during install (highly discouraged).

apt_offline_strict_deb_check.description: Delegate .deb checksum validation to apt (may trigger network checks even when offline).

apt_offline_install_src_path.description: Path where source packages should be installed during install operations.

apt_offline_sources_list_d_files.description: List of APT repository fragments for apt-offline setup. Required on fresh installs without network.
